name: Deepak Koul
description:
Deepak is an experienced engineering manager with a passion for psychology, software quality and now AI.  In his current role at Red Hat, Deepak is focused on building digital experiences for Red Hat Partners. Deepak has been a prolific international conference speaker (MCP Dev Summit 2026, devconf, seleniumconf, automationstar, ATAGTR) and tech meetup host. He runs Pune AI collective where AI enthusiasts from Pune, India talk and share about open source AI technologies and frameworks.

He was a speaker in FOASSIA Summit bangkok 2026 and also started his contribution journey with https://github.com/fossasia/eventyay/issues/4016.
